objective: Review the source-closure materialization run and decide whether the missing-source blocker is removed enough to define a scoped bridge-path launcher retry after materialization.

review_decision.reason: The materialization run checked out the required PULP ITA and common_cells submodules at tracked gitlink SHAs and verified that all 29 source files named by the pulp_ita_mha template exist in a clean worktree.
review_decision.weakest_point: This proves source availability only. It does not prove that the post-materialization launcher retry builds, runs the sidecar, reaches compare, passes coverage-output equivalence, measures timing, or exercises direct Verilator sidecar execution.
accepted_because: both required submodules matched tracked gitlink SHAs
missing source file count after materialization was 0
launcher retry was intentionally not performed by the materialization run gate

required_next_gate.name: define_verilator_native_option_parser_direct_command_path_native_invocation_verilator_process_launcher_bridge_after_source_closure_retry_gate
must_define: the exact clean-worktree command sequence for submodule materialization plus launcher retry
the expected failure classes if the retry stops after source closure
whether coverage-output compare may be claimed only if reached in the retry
that timing remains a separate gate
